verdicts.evidence: Strict parsing landed in 7eda67d49. On 2026-07-10 vseehausen wrote that InfraSec confirmed FF_ZERION_ENABLED=true is set on staging and production and that the "Deploy note [was] updated accordingly".

At b219480, .env.sample.json:754-756 had the description "(OPTIONAL)" but "required": true. Commit 7eda67d49 set "required": false and reworded the description, and its message says it marks the flag optional.

In the configuration.ts:207 thread, vseehausen agreed to call it `zerion` without `enabled` and to fold zerionPositions into it in a later PR. Commit faaddbf88 renamed features.zerionEnabled to features.zerion (src/config/entities/configuration.ts:427).
